1.explanation: The root of the issue lies in the definition of the `keyword` pattern in components/prism-typescript.js, which unconditionally treats the bare word “type” as a keyword (because it’s listed in the big alternation). This means that anywhere “type” appears, even in property names, it is highlighted as a keyword. Additionally, the `class-name` pattern also includes “type” in its alternation to match type declarations, which can further interfere with correct tokenization of the word. To fix this, the grammar must be refined so that “type” is only recognized as a keyword in declaration contexts (e.g., before identifiers in type alias or class/interface declarations), and not in object or interface property positions.
